SELECT
    week_start::text AS week_start,
    week_end::text AS week_end,
    report_markdown,
    metrics_snapshot,
    model_name,
    generated_at
FROM public.weekly_insights
WHERE week_end - week_start = 6
ORDER BY week_start DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    i.week_start::text AS week_start,
    i.generated_at::text AS report_generated_at,
    p.presentation_id AS existing_presentation_id,

    (p.presentation_id IS NULL) AS needs_generation

FROM public.weekly_insights i

LEFT JOIN public.weekly_presentations p
    ON p.week_start = i.week_start
    AND p.source_report_generated_at = i.generated_at

WHERE i.week_start = $1::date

LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.weekly_presentations (
    week_start,
    presentation_id,
    source_report_generated_at
)
VALUES (
    $1::date,
    $2::text,
    $3::timestamptz
)
ON CONFLICT (week_start)
DO UPDATE SET
    presentation_id = EXCLUDED.presentation_id,
    source_report_generated_at =
        EXCLUDED.source_report_generated_at,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING
    week_start::text AS week_start,
    presentation_id AS "presentationId";
